displayedInputs.question: One string has 10 beads, and another has 8. How many more beads does the string with 10 beads have than the string with 8 beads? Calculate: \(10-8=?\)
There are 4 pencils, and 5 more are added. How many pencils are there in all? Calculate: \(4+5=?\)
There are 8 candies. 2 are taken away. How many are left? Calculate: \(8-2=?\)
There is initially 1 bird perched in a tree. 6 more fly in, then another 2 fly in. How many birds are there now? Calculate: \(1+6+2=?\)
There are 10 cookies. 1 is eaten, then another 4 are eaten. How many are left? Calculate: \(10-1-4=?\)
There are 4 pens. 5 more are bought, and 6 are given away. How many are left? Calculate: \(4+5-6=?\)
Stand facing the blackboard. What is the side you are facing called?
There are 3 books on the upper part of a bookshelf and 2 books on the lower part. How many books are there in total in the upper and lower parts? Calculate: \(3+2=?\)
There are 4 students in front and 1 student behind. How many people are there in front and behind altogether? Calculate: \(4+1=?\)
A two-digit number has 1 in the tens place and 4 in the ones place. What is the number?
What is the tens digit of 17?
What is the ones digit of 17?
A two-digit number has 1 in the tens place and 8 in the ones place. What is the number?
What is the ones digit of 20?
There are 11 colored pens, and 4 more are brought over. How many pens are there altogether? Calculate: \(11+4=?\)
When using the make-ten method to calculate \(9+3\), which pair of numbers is it more convenient to split 3 into?
